about.title: Hi, I'm Omar
about.body1: I’m a software engineer based in Qatar and the person behind {app}. I build bilingual websites and web apps, including an education platform and a live events calendar for Doha.
about.body2: I focus on making each project easy to use, fast to load, and straightforward to maintain. I also create animated explainers and short videos.

items.a: Send a message on WhatsApp or an email with a short description of what you need. I'll reply with questions, ideas and a quote.
Every project is quoted individually after a quick chat — there are no fixed packages.
It depends on the size of the project. You'll get a clear timeline before any work starts.
Yes. Websites and videos can be made in English, Arabic, or both.
Of course. We refine the work together until you're happy with it.

anees.name: Anees
anees.body: A Qatari-themed learning platform for students: short lesson reels in a swipe feed, quizzes that earn XP, a 50-level adventure map with boss battles, practice worksheets and a studio for teachers. Arabic and English, light and dark.

datebook.name: Doha Datebook
datebook.body: A live calendar of what's on in Doha. Events update automatically from a live feed, on the web and in an Android app.

privacy.title: Privacy
body: {app} only collects what you choose to share — usually your name, phone number and project details when you message on WhatsApp.
We use this information to reply to you and deliver your project, and for nothing else. We do not sell personal data, and this website does not use third-party tracking.
To have your information deleted, send a message on WhatsApp.

terms.title: Terms
body: Work is delivered as agreed in our chat, including the price and the timeline.
You own the final websites and videos once the project is paid for. You are responsible for the content and materials you send us.
{app} may show finished work in its showcase unless you ask us not to. Questions? Message on WhatsApp.
